decision.reason: Demand and premium mix are slightly down but stable, and return rates are low and consistent across merchants. The premium_alternative candidate (331960fbf3c19b) shows the most favorable expected value under steady conditions compared to other options, while maintaining a short duration to mitigate risk.

decision.reason: Demand and premium mix are both declining, and Oak & Ink is at its minimum observed inventory level. A short-duration (3-day) premium alternative campaign at stores 1 and 2 is selected to test engagement without over-extending inventory or risking further return pressure. The observe candidate was considered as a conservative alternative given the softening market.
